nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 使用 whose、when 與非限定關係子句，並讓補充資訊連到正確先行詞。
nodes.form: defining or non-defining relative clause with clear antecedent

naturalExamples.text: The student whose idea won is in my class.
June is the month when we present our project.
Ms. Lee, who teaches science, checked our design.
The device that measures air quality is on the roof.

wrong.text: Ms. Lee who teaches science checked our design.

better.text: Ms. Lee, who teaches science, checked our design.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 若 Ms. Lee 身分已明確，非必要補充資訊通常以逗號隔開。

wrong.text: We spoke to the engineer about the device who designed it.

better.text: We spoke to the engineer who designed the device.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: who 子句應緊接它所描述的 engineer，避免錯誤附著。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 那位腳踏車被偷的學生報警了。

wrong.text: The student who bike was stolen called the police.

better.text: The student whose bike was stolen called the police.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 表示所屬關係使用 whose。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我們在五月完成，那是雨季開始的月份。

wrong.text: We finished in May, which the rainy season begins.

better.text: We finished in May, when the rainy season begins.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 指時間並表示在那時發生，使用 when。

nodes.titleEn: Modal Deduction and Degrees of Certainty
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 must、may、might、could、can't 表達有證據的不同確定程度。
nodes.form: modal + base form; modal + have + past participle for past deduction

naturalExamples.text: The lights are on, so someone must be home.
This key might open the old box.
The answer could be in the report.
That can't be Ben; he is at school.

wrong.text: Someone must to be home.

better.text: Someone must be home.

wrong.text: It must rain tomorrow because the sky is cloudy.

better.text: It might rain tomorrow because the sky is cloudy.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 多雲只能支持可能性，使用 must 會顯得過度確定。

wrong.text: She must have forgotten.

better.text: She might have forgotten.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 只有可能性時使用 might have；must have 表強烈推論。

wrong.text: That must not be true.

better.text: That can't be true.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 表達邏輯上不可能時，can't be 通常更直接自然。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依對象與目的調整請求、用字、縮寫與語氣。
nodes.form: choose wording and contraction level for audience

naturalExamples.text: Could you please send me the schedule?
Hey, can you send me the plan?
I would like to request more information.
We found out that the event was canceled.

wrong.text: Hey, teacher, give me the form.

better.text: Could you please give me the form?

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 對老師提出請求時，後者語氣較合適。

wrong.text: I wanna obtain the document.

better.text: I would like to obtain the document.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: wanna 與 obtain 的語體混合，正式請求應保持一致。

wrong.text: Send me the details.

better.text: Could you please send me the details?

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 直接命令可能顯得突兀；請求句較自然。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我們在正式報告中發現污染增加。

wrong.text: We found out pollution got worse.

better.text: We found that pollution had increased.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 正式報告使用較精確且一致的語體。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 縮寫較常見於口語與一般書信；完整形式可較正式或帶強調。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 讓 it、they、this、these 等清楚指向前文，必要時重複關鍵名詞。

naturalExamples.text: The bridge had a loose board. This problem made it unsafe.
Mia interviewed two nurses. They described the same issue.
We changed the bus route. The new route reduced travel time.
The report and the map disagreed, so we checked both sources.

wrong.text: The map was beside the report, but it was outdated.

better.text: The map was beside the report, but the map was outdated.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: it 可能指 map 或 report；重複名詞可消除歧義。

wrong.text: We moved the meeting online. This was helpful.

better.text: We moved the meeting online. This change helped more students attend.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: this 後補上概括名詞 change，資訊更清楚。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: John 告訴 Peter，他需要更多時間。

wrong.text: John told Peter that he needed more time.

better.text: John told Peter, "I need more time."

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 原句 he 指涉不清；直接引語可明確指出 John。

wrong.text: The device broke. This caused a delay.

better.text: The device broke. This failure caused a delay.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 原句可接受；正式說明加入 failure 更精確。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 使用冒號、分號、破折號、括號與連字號組織資訊，而不製造逗號拼接。
nodes.form: colon for introduction; semicolon for related clauses; dash/brackets for parenthesis; hyphen in compounds

naturalExamples.text: We need three things: paper, tape, and scissors.
The first plan is cheaper; the second is safer.
The final test—our most difficult task—starts tomorrow.
We designed a low-cost water filter.

wrong.text: The first plan is cheaper, the second is safer.

better.text: The first plan is cheaper; the second is safer.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 兩個完整句不能只用逗號連接。

wrong.text: We need: paper, tape, and scissors.

better.text: We need three things: paper, tape, and scissors.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 冒號前通常需要能獨立成立並完整引出後文的結構。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 報告有兩部分：問題和建議。

wrong.text: The report has two parts; the problem and the recommendation.

better.text: The report has two parts: the problem and the recommendation.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 後面是前句引出的清單，使用冒號。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 這是一個為期三天的活動。

wrong.text: This is a three day event.

better.text: This is a three-day event.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 數字與單數名詞共同放在名詞前作複合修飾語時加連字號。

forms: The final test—our hardest task—starts tomorrow.
The final test (our hardest task) starts tomorrow.
acceptableVariants.noteZh: 破折號較有強調感；括號通常較像附帶資訊。

wrong.text: I very like this book.

better.text: I really like this book.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: very 通常不直接修飾動詞 like；使用 really。

wrong.text: We discussed about the problem.

better.text: We discussed the problem.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: discuss 直接接受詞，不加 about。

wrong.text: Please enter into the room quietly.

better.text: Please enter the room quietly.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: enter 在此可直接接受詞 room，into 顯得多餘。

wrong.text: We returned back to school.

better.text: We returned to school.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: return 已包含「回」的意思，back 通常多餘。
